about_the_game:
A nightmare beyond your wildest dreams...

STORY

Desperate for a fresh start, Juan and his cat, Pancake, leave everything behind, chasing the promise of a new life. What begins as a dream opportunity quickly warps into a waking nightmare. Trapped in darkness teeming with monsters, he discovers digital fragments of his past and ventures deeper into the nightmare worlds in search of a way out.

FORCE RESTART is a first-person psychological survival horror game set within the VOID, a shifting abyss. Experienced entirely in first person, Juan must explore, evade, and survive using a limited set of weapons and tools. Scattered memory fragments pull him into distorted worlds, where unraveling their secrets is the only path forward.

Every descent reveals more than just escape, forcing him to confront what was lost, what remains, and what refuses to stay buried.

DON'T CLOSE YOUR EYES

Experience twisted realities in first person for a more thrilling, more immersive experience as you explore the VOID and come face-to-face with what’s waiting inside.

DIVE INTO DARKNESS

Explore shifting worlds that unravel around you, filled with environmental clues, puzzles, and unsettling events woven throughout.

WATCH YOUR BACK

Weapons aren’t enough. Scavenge to survive, recover, and push forward, because what you carry and what you leave behind can change everything.

FEARS BECOME REALITY

With striking visuals, cinematic lighting, and haunting soundscapes pulling you into the VOID, you’ll feel like you’ve stepped into a nightmare.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

name: Force Restart

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4460 or AMD FX™-6300 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 or AMD Radeon™ RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: This game is expected to run at 1080p/30 FPS. If you have don't have enough graphics memory to run the game at your selected texture quality, you must go to Options > Graphics and lower the texture quality or shadow quality, or decrease the resolution.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-3770 or AMD FX™-9590 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 480 with 3GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: This game is expected to run at 1080p/60 FPS.

short_description: FORCE RESTART is a first-person psychological survival horror game. An evil force creeps into a man's life, twisting his reality. Plunged into the VOID, a shifting abyss, he must explore mind-bending nightmares, unravel its mysteries, and confront the monsters to escape… or be lost to it forever.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
